verdict.rationale: Bitwarden publishes a first-party MCP server (bitwarden/mcp-server on GitHub, published to npm) that gives AI assistants access to password manager functionality. A runtime probe completed a full stdio initialize handshake with it via `npx -y @bitwarden/mcp-server`, so this is hands-on confirmation rather than only a vendor claim. missing for 10: detailed documentation in the pack of the specific tools and the 'two complementary interfaces' the server exposes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides AI assistants with secure access to Bitwarden password manager functionality through two complementary interfaces:
Bitwarden's OFFICIAL MCP server completed a FULL keyless stdio initialize handshake — `npx -y @bitwarden/mcp-server` answered with serverInfo {"name":"Bitwarden MCP Server","version":"2026.7.0"}.
official MCP server documented at https://github.com/bitwarden/mcp-server
